chapter_en: Chapter 26: Seeking and opening a school post

units.chapter_en: Chapter 26: Seeking and opening a school post
units.title: 求馆开设：以世应为主、财福为凭；觅馆招贤怕世空，应空岂得遇东翁，父空书馆终非美，才陷修仪甚不丰，世应不空须有望，变成冲散定无终；世为自己、应为东家、父为书馆、子为书生、财为束修、鬼为荐馆之人、兄乃同胞之士，逢空各有所缺

rule.yi: 求馆（谋求教书的馆席），以世爻、应爻为主，以妻财、子孙为凭据。求馆、受聘最怕世爻落空，应爻落空就遇不到东家；父爻落空，这个馆终究不是好馆；财爻陷入空亡，束修（馆金）很不丰厚。世爻、应爻都不落空，就必定有希望；如果变成冲散，就一定做不长久。六亲各取一象：世是自己，应是东家，父是书馆，子是书生，财是束修，鬼是荐馆的人，兄是同胞之士。落空各有所缺：世空遇不到尊重、听从自己的人，应空没有东家接纳，父空难遇好馆，财空束修菲薄，子空学生不多，鬼空无人举荐，兄空无人来争，身空住处不安；其余的空还可以稍微放过，只要世应不空，终究有希望。
rule.en: In seeking a school post, take the Self and the Other as the chief and Wealth and Output as the ground. To seek a post and be engaged, the Self falling Void is the thing most to be feared, and if the Other is Void one cannot meet the host; if Resource is Void the school is in the end no fine one; if Wealth is sunk into Void the fee is very meagre. If neither the Self nor the Other is Void there must be hope; if it changes into a scattering clash there will surely be no lasting end. The six kin each take one image: the Self is oneself, the Other the host, Resource the school, Output the pupils, Wealth the fee, Pressure the one who recommends a post, Peer the men of one's own kind. A Void in each leaves something lacking: if the Self is Void one meets no one who honours and follows one, if the Other is Void there is no host to take one in, if Resource is Void it is hard to meet a good post, if Wealth is Void the fee is slight, if Output is Void the pupils are few, if Pressure is Void no one recommends one, if Peer is Void no one competes, and if the Body is Void the place one lives is unsettled; the other Voids may be set aside somewhat, and if the Self and the Other are not Void there will in the end be hope.

yi: 以世爻、应爻为主要看的，以妻财、子孙（财福）为凭据。
en: Take the Self and the Other as the chief to be looked at, and Wealth and Output as the ground.

zh: 觅馆招贤怕世空。应空岂得遇东翁，
父空书馆终非美，才陷修仪甚不丰，
世应不空须有望，变成冲散定无终，
无官之卦休寻访，无馆之年为六冲。
yi: 寻觅馆席、受聘为师，最怕世爻落空；应爻落空，怎么能遇到东家？
父爻落空，这个馆终究不是好馆；财爻陷入空亡，束修（馆金）很不丰厚。
世爻、应爻都不落空，就必定有希望；如果变成冲散，就一定做不长久。
没有官鬼的卦，就不要去寻访；没有馆席的年份，卦是六冲。
en: In seeking a post and being engaged as a worthy tutor, the Self falling Void is the thing to fear; if the Other is Void, how can one meet the host?
If Resource is Void, the school is in the end no fine one; if Wealth is sunk into Void, the fee is very meagre.
If neither the Self nor the Other is Void there must be hope; if it changes into a scattering clash there will surely be no lasting end.
A hexagram with no Pressure line, do not go seeking; the year with no post is the six-clash.

zh: 凡图书馆，世为自己，应为东家，父为书馆，子为书生，财为束修，鬼为荐馆之人，兄乃同胞之士，世空不遇尊从，应空无东纳。
父空难逢美馆，财空修体轻微。
子空门弟不多，鬼空无人举荐，兄空无人抢夺，身空居处不安，诸空稍可推，得世应不空终须有望。
yi: 凡是谋求书馆的，世爻代表自己，应爻代表东家，父爻代表书馆，子孙代表学生，妻财代表束修，官鬼代表荐馆的人，兄弟是同胞之士；世爻落空，遇不到尊重、听从自己的人；应爻落空，就没有东家接纳。
父爻落空，难遇好馆；财爻落空，束修轻微。
子孙落空，学生不多；官鬼落空，无人举荐；兄弟落空，无人来争抢；卦身落空，住的地方不安稳；其余各空还可以稍微放过，只要世应不空，终究有希望。
en: Whenever one plans for a school post, the Self is oneself, the Other is the host, Resource is the school, Output is the pupils, Wealth is the fee, Pressure is the one who recommends one to the post, and Peer is the men of one's own kind; if the Self is Void one meets no one who honours and follows one, and if the Other is Void there is no host to take one in.
If Resource is Void it is hard to meet a good post; if Wealth is Void the fee is slight.

If Output is Void the pupils are not many; if Pressure is Void no one recommends one; if Peer is Void no one competes for the post; if the Body is Void the place where one lives is unsettled; the other Voids may be set aside somewhat, and if the Self and the Other are not Void there will in the end be hope.

note.yi: 「图书馆」是谋求书馆（教书的馆席），不是今天说的图书馆；「东翁」「东家」是聘请塾师的主人；「束修」是学生送给老师的酬金，这里指馆金；「荐馆之人」是介绍你去这个馆的人。诀里「才陷修仪」的「才」疑是「财」，解里「财空修体轻微」的「修体」疑是「修仪」，译文按「财」「修仪」译；「诸空稍可推」的「推」按「放过」译。「兄乃同胞之士」从后面「兄空无人抢夺」看，指来争这个馆的同行。这一条的六亲取象与黄金策求馆（HJC.29 起）、易隐觅馆占（YY.79）是同一套：世自己、应东家、父书馆、子学生、财馆金、鬼荐馆人、兄谋占者。
note.en: 'Tu shuguan' means to plan for a school post (a tutor's place) and not a library as the words mean today; 'dongweng' and 'dongjia' are the master who engages a tutor, 'shuxiu' is the fee that pupils give a teacher, here the pay of the post, and 'the one who recommends one to a post' is the person who introduces one to it. The 'cai' of 'cai xian xiuyi' in the verse is presumably 'cai', Wealth, and the 'xiuti' of 'cai kong xiuti qingwei' in the explanation is presumably 'xiuyi', the fee; the translation reads them so, and the 'tui' of 'zhu kong shao ke tui' is read as 'set aside'. From 'if Peer is Void no one competes for the post' later on, 'the men of one's own kind' means those in the same line who compete for the post. The kin images here are the same set as in the Huangjin Ce on seeking a post (from HJC.29) and in the Yi Yin divination for seeking a post (YY.79): the Self is oneself, the Other the host, Resource the school, Output the pupils, Wealth the pay, Pressure the one who recommends, Peer the one who schemes to take it.

units.chapter_en: Chapter 26: Seeking and opening a school post
units.title: 求馆开设：凡值六冲之卦或无官鬼定无馆也；如合处逢冲或变出六冲虽见成就其年定主不终；游魂迁改它图吉、归魂乃旧胜西东；问迁更游魂大利、占守旧反要归魂

rule.yi: 凡是遇到六冲的卦，或者卦里没有官鬼，一定没有馆席；合的地方遇到冲，或者变出六冲，即使看着已经成了，那一年也一定做不到头。游魂卦，改换去别处另谋是吉；归魂卦，是守着旧馆，胜过东奔西走。所以问迁移更换的，游魂卦大为有利；占守旧馆的，反倒要归魂卦。
rule.en: Whenever the hexagram is a six-clash, or there is no Pressure line in it, there will surely be no post; if where there is a combination it meets a clash, or it changes out a six-clash, then even if the post seems to be settled, that year it will surely not last to the end. With a Wandering Soul hexagram, to move and change and plan for another post is auspicious; a Returning Soul hexagram is for the old post, better than going east and west. So for asking about moving to a change, a Wandering Soul is greatly favourable; for divining about keeping the old post, a Returning Soul is on the contrary what is wanted.

zh: 凡值六冲之卦或无官鬼定无馆也。
如合处逢冲或变出六冲，虽见成就，其年定主不终。
yi: 凡是遇到六冲的卦，或者卦里没有官鬼，一定没有馆席。
如果合的地方遇到冲，或者变出六冲，即使看着已经成了，那一年也一定做不到头。
en: Whenever the hexagram is a six-clash, or has no Pressure line, there will surely be no post.
If where there is a combination it meets a clash, or it changes out a six-clash, then even if it seems to be settled, that year it will surely not last to the end.

zh: 游魂迁改它图吉，归魂乃旧胜西东，
yi: 游魂卦，改换去别处另谋是吉；归魂卦，是守着旧馆，胜过东奔西走。
en: With a Wandering Soul hexagram, to move and change and plan for another post is auspicious; a Returning Soul hexagram is for the old post, which is better than going east and west.

zh: 问迁更、游魂大利，占守旧，反要归魂，
yi: 问迁移更换的，游魂卦大为有利；占守旧馆的，反倒要归魂卦。
en: For asking about moving to a change, a Wandering Soul hexagram is greatly favourable; for divining about keeping to the old post, on the contrary a Returning Soul hexagram is wanted.

note.yi: 「游魂」「归魂」是八宫卦里每宫的第七卦和第八卦（见术语表）。「迁改它图」是改换去别处另谋，「西东」是东奔西走，这里指换馆奔走。「合处逢冲」按文意是本来成合的地方遇到冲，「变出六冲」是变卦成了六冲卦，书里没有再解释。这一条与易隐觅馆占「游魂宜别图，归魂宜仍旧」「六冲无馆、六合有馆」（YY.80）取同一个关系；「游魂」「归魂」只管换不换馆，不管成不成，成不成要看别的爻。
note.en: 'Wandering Soul' and 'Returning Soul' are the seventh and eighth hexagrams of each of the eight palaces (see the glossary). 'Qian gai ta tu' is to change and plan for another post elsewhere, and 'xi dong' is running east and west, here the running about of changing posts. 'Where there is a combination it meets a clash' is, by the sense, a place that was a combination meeting a clash, and 'changes out a six-clash' is the changed hexagram being a six-clash hexagram; the book does not explain them further. This entry takes the same relations as 'a Wandering Soul suits planning elsewhere, a Returning Soul suits keeping to the old' and 'a six-clash has no post, a six-combine has a post' in the Yi Yin divination for seeking a post (YY.80); the Wandering Soul and Returning Soul decide only whether one changes posts and not whether one succeeds, which is read from the other lines.

units.chapter_en: Chapter 26: Seeking and opening a school post
units.title: 求馆开设：那日扶持生合世便教宾主两相逢；要知那日成关还详父母——卦中无父但逢值日方在，有父爻旺求墓合之时，衰取旺生之日，又看何日生世、空世亦可成关

rule.yi: 要知道哪一天定下这个馆，要细看父母爻：卦里有父爻而且旺相，取它入墓、逢合的时候；父爻衰弱，取它旺相、得生的日子；卦里没有父爻，要等到它当值的那一天才算在。还要看哪一天生世爻，世爻落空的也可以在那一天成。到了扶助、生合世爻的那一天，宾（师）主（东家）两方就会相见。
rule.en: To know on which day the engagement is settled, one must look closely at Resource: if Resource is in the hexagram and thriving, take the time when it enters the tomb or meets a combination; if it is weak, take the day when it thrives or is generated; if it is not in the hexagram, it is present only when the day on which it is on duty comes. Look also for the day that generates the Self; even a Void Self can then be settled. On the day that aids, generates or combines with the Self, guest and host come to meet each other.

zh: 那日扶持生合世，便教宾主两相逢。
yi: 到了扶助、生、合世爻的那一天，就会让宾（师）主（东家）两方相见。
en: On the day that aids, generates or combines with the Self, guest and host are made to meet each other.

zh: 要知那日成关，还详父母。
卦中无父，但逢值日方在。
如有父爻旺，求墓合之时。
衰取旺生之日，又看何日生世、空世亦可成关。
yi: 要知道是哪一天定下这个馆，还要细看父母爻。
卦中没有父爻的，要等到它当值的日子才算在。
如果有父爻而且旺相，就要找它入墓、逢合的时候。
父爻衰弱的，取它旺相、得生的日子；又要看哪一天生世爻；世爻落空的，也可以成就这个馆。
en: To know on which day the engagement is settled, one must still look closely at Resource.
If there is no Resource in the hexagram, it is present only when the day on which it is on duty comes.
If Resource is present and thriving, look for the time when it enters the tomb or meets a combination.
If it is weak, take the day when it thrives or is generated; look also for the day that generates the Self; even with the Self Void the engagement can be settled.

note.yi: 「成关」的「关」应是关书（聘请塾师的聘书），「成关」就是把聘定下来；书里没有解释，这里按这个意思译。「卦中无父，但逢值日方在」按字面译：卦里没有父爻，要等到它当值的日子才算在；书里没有说「当值」按什么取，这里不加解释。「求墓合之时」的「墓」是父爻的墓库，「合」是与父爻相合的地支（见术语表）。末句「空世亦可成关」字面是世爻落空也能成；前面说世空遇不到尊从，这里说的是逢到生世的日子仍可成就，两处并不相冲。这一条与易隐觅馆占「关约何日来」（YY.81）取同一个法：旺则墓合日、衰则生旺日、无父则值日，又看生合世之日。
note.en: The 'guan' of 'cheng guan' is presumably the 'guanshu', the letter of engagement by which a tutor is hired, and 'cheng guan' is the engagement being settled; the book does not explain it, and the translation takes it so. 'If there is no Resource in the hexagram, it is present only when the day on which it is on duty comes' is translated literally: the book does not say by what the 'duty' is reckoned, and nothing is added here. In 'qiu mu he zhi shi' the 'tomb' is the tomb of the Resource line and the 'combination' is the branch that combines with it (see the glossary). The last sentence, 'a Void Self too can settle the engagement', literally says that a Void Self can still be settled; earlier it said that a Void Self meets no one who honours and follows one, and what is said here is that on a day that generates the Self it can still be accomplished, so the two places do not clash. This entry takes the same method as 'on what day the engagement comes' in the Yi Yin divination for seeking a post (YY.81): a thriving line by the tomb or combination day, a weak one by a generating or thriving day, a missing one by its duty day, and also the day that generates or combines with the Self.
